scope: R44 direction review of existing M5 goal model independent of EV-first selection

architecture.fit: per-league independent home/away Poisson with team attack/defence and ridge penalty
architecture.time: calendar-year walk-forward; prior-year validation selects penalty; annual Jan 1 predictions
limitations: team parameters frozen within calendar year
M5 baseline not automatically superior to Crown prices

prior_goal_calibration.method: per-league multiplicative home/away goal-rate correction from M5 OOS forecasts and settled scores, shrunk toward all-league factor by kappa pseudo-expected goals; apply to the complete M5 score grid via exponential tilting. No Crown ROI enters calibration.

decision: Keep M5 as an existing research baseline; insufficient evidence that it is a profitable AH strategy. Research direction should test score/goal calibration and independent incremental signal versus market before EV-based selection. No new rules, production changes, or strategy switches.
source_caveats: Existing 2025/2026 Crown paired quotes were retrospectively retrieved after kickoff
Historical model comparisons do not prove independent future trading edge
Score NLL improvement is small; statistical significance and direct price-edge improvement not established
